Compute the required total and subtract the sum of the $6$ known values.
solution_steps_latex: Required total for $7$ values with mean $19$: $7 \cdot 19 = 133$.
Sum of the known values: $37, 10, 36, 27, 12, 6$ gives $128$.
Missing value: $133 - 128 = 5$.
